The definition of sech⁡x is sech⁡x=1cosh⁡x=2ex+e−x.

sech⁡(ln⁡t)=2eln⁡t+e−ln⁡t=2eln⁡t+eln⁡(t)−1=2t+(t)−1=2(t+1t)=2(t+1t)=2tt+1.

$$
